name: Pomo
author: Raja
description: Hybrid Pomo desk client for the Omarchy bar. Offline Pomodoro with LAN import/adopt; phone owns the live clock once synced.

barWidget.description: Pomodoro remaining, phase, and phone connection on the bar. Click for controls and pairing.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Choose what the bar shows. Hover always shows the remaining time.

schema.label: Phone host
schema.description: Optional. Skip mDNS and use this host. Leave empty to browse _pomo._tcp.

schema.label: Pairing token
schema.description: From Pomo Settings. Also stored mode 0600 under $XDG_DATA_HOME/pomo/omarchy/config.json.

schema.label: Paste pairing JSON
schema.description: The {url, token} payload from Android Settings. Applied once, then stored by the engine.
